# OpenAlex search page (recorded)

`page-0.json` is the first 25 works of a REAL `GET /works` response (OpenAlex data is CC0),
reduced to one page: `meta.count` is 25 and `meta.next_cursor` is null; the works, abstracts,
authorships and topics are untouched. Used offline by `scripts/clean_install_scenario.py`.
